title: The Ten Plagues
intro: God sent ten plagues upon Egypt to free Israel from slavery. Each plague struck at Egyptian gods and demonstrated the Lord's power.

items.title: Water Turned to Blood
items.text: The Nile and all the water in Egypt turned to blood. The fish died, and the water stank.

items.title: Frogs
items.text: Frogs came up from the Nile and filled the whole land—even the beds and ovens.

items.title: Gnats
items.text: All the dust in the land turned into gnats that plagued people and animals.

items.title: Flies
items.text: Swarms of flies filled Egypt, but not Goshen where the Israelites lived.

items.title: Livestock Disease
items.text: All Egyptian livestock died, but not one of the Israelites' animals was harmed.

items.title: Boils
items.text: Boils broke out on people and animals throughout Egypt.

items.title: Hail
items.text: Severe hail mixed with fire struck down everything in the fields.

items.title: Locusts
items.text: Locusts covered the whole land and ate everything that the hail had spared.

items.title: Darkness
items.text: Thick darkness for three days—so dense it could be felt. But the Israelites had light.

items.title: Death of the Firstborn
items.text: All the firstborn in Egypt died, from Pharaoh's son to the prisoner's son. The Passover lamb protected Israel.
